description: Embeds one text or up to 64 through POST /v1/embeddings with an embedding model id from list_models (type embedding) and returns one vector per text, in order, with the token usage and the charge. Billed to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header.

input.description: One text, or up to 64 texts, to embed.

model.description: An embedding model id from list_models (type embedding).

name: embed
title: Turn text into vectors
